QuestInfo.name: [Sleepywood] Manji's Apprentice
QuestInfo.0: Chunji of Sleepywood has something to ask of you.
QuestInfo.1: Manji asked his young apprentice, #bMu Young#k, to investigate. Unfortunately, Mu Young hasn't been heard from since he entered #bSleepywood Dungeon#k. Could he still be inside?
QuestInfo.2: Manji told you about a dark energy coming from Sleepywood that he asked his young apprentice, #bMu Young#k, to investigate. Unfortunately, Mu Young hasn't been heard from since he entered #bSleepywood Dungeon#k. Could he still be inside?\rYou found Mu Young in the Sleepywood Underground Temple.
QuestInfo.summary: Go find Mu Young in the Sleepywood underground. He must be somewhere in the Underground Temple.

0.0: Manji asked me another favor, but I'm pretty busy. That means I have something for you to do.
0.1: Did Manji tell you about the time he faced Balrog? This was when Tristan the hero saved him.
0.2: He said that's been coming back to haunt him lately. Like, Balrog is calling him or something... So he asked #bMu Young#k, his apprentice, to go investigate the Sleepywood Dungeon. I don't know why he's not doing it himself. What does he do all alone on that rock in Perion, anyway? Bah.
0.3: But it's been over a month since Mu Young left. This is the last message that he sent: \r\n#b'Master, your problems are always at the beginning and the end! I must search the dungeon where it all started. I'll contact you again soon!'#k

yes.0: Can you find Manji's apprentice for me? I'm tied up with Ilji here. #bMu Young#k is probably at the #bBottom of the Temple#k, in the deeper parts of Sleepywood Dungeon.

1.0:
You're the first human I've seen in a long time. Who are you?

#b#L0#I'm #h0#. Are you Mu Young?#l
#k
1.1:
Yes, that's correct. I'm Mu Young. How in the world did you know my name?

#b#L0#I came to find you at the request of your master Manji.#l
#k
1.2: Ah, I didn't mean to worry him. I've been nothing but a burden...

yes.0: I appreciate that you came all this way to find me. We both know how tough it is to get here... I'm so sorry you had to go through all that trouble.

npc.0: That last time Manji heard from him, he was heading into the #bSleepywood underground dungeon#k, but he's been missing ever since. Please go after him. I can't afford to leave the town right now.
